Topics covered in this PDF

BHIM-162 (History of Bharat (From 8th Century to 17th Century CE)) - the questions solved in this PDF are on these topics:

  • Rajput kingdoms, crafts from the 8th to 12th century, Mahmud Ghazanavi, Vijayanagara art and architecture, mansabdari
  • Agrarian rebellion in the Sultanate, Sufi tradition, the Rathore resistance, Ibadat Khana, Suhummung of Ahom

These topics are taken from the questions in this PDF. Check the official syllabus and assignment paper for your session with IGNOU.

Assignment pattern

As printed on the first page of the PDF:

  • The cover prints: three assignments, answer all questions, marks 100, assignment code BHIM-162/ASST/TMA/2026-27. Assignment I: two questions of 20 marks (about 500 words each). Assignment II: three questions of 10 marks (about 250 words each). Assignment III: five questions of 6 marks (about 100 words each)

Always check your session's assignment paper and submission deadline on the official IGNOU website or with your study centre.
